mostWorthwhile.text: Making the rain shadow was worthwhile: one mountain range created a clear contrast between wetter and drier climates.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the desert felt less informative than making the rain shadow; the automatic Sun combination completed the goal without explaining its particular role.

surprise.text: Inspecting the planet automatically used Air to create axial tilt; the subsequent explanation clarified why tilt, rather than proximity to the Sun, drives Earth's seasons.

arbitrary.text: Air tipping the planet was not an obvious physical inference, even though the resulting explanation of tilt was clear.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the different landscapes support life; the connections among mountains, climate and glacial rivers made the world's unfolding interesting.
